name: io.github.nadeaup/mineryield-mcp
title: MinerYield
description: Home/small-biz ASIC profit with solar and battery. Estimates; API key required.

environmentVariables.name: MINERYIELD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer API key created at https://mineryield.com/api while signed in. Required for authenticated tools; never commit the value.

environmentVariables.name: MINERYIELD_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional API origin. Defaults to https://mineryield.com.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Required. Create a key at https://mineryield.com/api while signed in. Hosted MCP is not keyless: unauthenticated requests return HTTP 401.
